text:
Lina: quick thought 12 - what if we trim the left nav to 6 items and put Models + Deployments under a single collapsible 'Runtime' group? keeps top row lean.
Omar: I like the declutter. Important: deep links like /deployments/xyz must still land and highlight correctly even if group is collapsed.
Priya: Routing contract proposal: canonical paths remain flat (e.g., /deployments/:id, /models/:id). No hash fragments. On client hydrate, resolve path -> sidebar node, expand any ancestors, then set focus on the leaf link only for initial load.
Lina: Good. For client logic: findNodeForPath(path) -> if node has collapsed parents open them then focus(node.element). Pseudocode: `const node = find(path); expandAncestors(node); if (initialLoad) node.el.focus();`
Omar: Accessibility: group toggle must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Announce expansion via a polite live region: "Runtime expanded, 3 items". Honor prefers-reduced-motion for expand animation.
Priya: Breadcrumbs: when at /models/foo/versions/1.2 show: Runtime > Foo > Versions > 1.2. Avoid repeating 'Runtime' inside crumbs; show humanized names.
Lina: Visual indicator idea different from badge/underline: a thin left accent bar on the group header when the active route is inside it. Works with compact nav. Poll: :thumbsup: for accent bar, :eyes: for group badge.
Omar: :thumbsup:
Priya: :eyes:
Design-Bot: Reminder: attach updated Figma frames and annotated interactions before review tomorrow 9:30am.
QA-Bot: Test plan notes: 1) E2E: land on /deployments/:id when group collapsed -> group should expand and leaf be focused. 2) Unit: aria-expanded toggles, live region text set. 3) Accessibility: screenreader reads "Runtime collapsed"/"expanded" and focus order preserved.
Lina: Edge-case: overlapping slugs (e.g., /projects/:id and /models/:id). Match by longest static prefix first, then sidebar order tie-breaker.
Omar: URL normalization: remove duplicate slashes and trailing slash on server with 301 to canonical. Client should also normalize on navigate to avoid duplicate breadcrumb states.
Priya: Small UX nit: when user navigates client-side from one leaf to another in different groups, don't steal focus if they initiated the navigation (only focus on external/bookmark landing). Keep subtle expand/collapse animation unless prefers-reduced-motion.
Lina: I'll author the RFC PR: canonical paths, client hydrate behavior, focus rules, ARIA semantics, accent-bar spec, and test checklist. Tagging @Omar and @Priya for review.
Omar: One more: keyboard users should be able to toggle group headers with Enter/Space and arrow keys to move between visible items. Add key handlers and document behavior.
Priya: Also ensure that collapsed children are removed from tab order (tabindex=-1) and have aria-hidden=true.
Design-Bot: Note: include micro-interaction notes in Figma (reduced motion variant + SR text).
Lina: Thanks all. Will post PR link and Figma when ready.
Omar: :thumbsup: 
Priya: :thumbsup:
